speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do you like this city and why?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Honestly, I'm not really a city person, and I don't like this city — but that doesn't mean I hate it. I just don't like it, you know. I grew up in the southern part of China, so I never got used to it here: it's too cold in winter and too dry. Also, the prices are higher — things here cost more than where I used to live.
